count_820.detail: Pinned formatter guard returns before dereferencing the out-of-range final pointer; the show callback returns 4100 and sysfs clamps it to 4095.

zero_count.detail: ASan observed a write beginning one byte before buf. The stock awrw_store parser rejects count zero before updating state, so this was not established as reachable through the normal writer.

body_and_kcfi.detail: The 260-byte function body matches stock; KCFI type ID matches. STB_GLOBAL versus STB_LOCAL is internal visibility and neither symbol is exported through __ksymtab.

harness.detail: Differential harness compares the reconstructed C to a separate stock-flow transcription; it does not execute the candidate module or test concurrent store/show lifetime.

lifetime.detail: A controlled concurrent awrw_store/awrw_show run under KASAN/KCSAN, or an equivalent lock/lifetime proof, remains outstanding.
